context:
Goal: the app ships only to the devices you named.
Problem (goal): your pick 216 a set iPhone only, but Mac and Vision Pro "Designed for iPhone" availability stays at Xcode's default (on), and no ruling covers it.
Based on (ruling): 216 a (22:20 CST): iPhone only.
Based on (read): lane adblock-iphone-only, ios-adblock #144.
Departs from: ios-adblock main, where Mac and Vision Pro may run the iPhone app — option b turns both off.

options.gain: No work; the app runs on Apple Silicon Macs and Vision Pro.
options.label: Leave on (Xcode default)

options.gain: What ships is what CI tests.
options.how: #144 also turns off Mac and Vision Pro availability.
options.label: Turn both off
options.lose: No Mac or Vision Pro install.

title: ios-adblock: turn off the iPhone app on Apple Silicon Macs and Vision Pro too?
why: Recommended: b. It matches 216's goal: every shipped device is tested. Meanwhile #144 goes on in its batch.
